rules.description: Institutes/Schools must submit a registration request to join NSP by completing the online registration form.
rules.condition: Institute/School wishes to onboard on NSP
rules.outcome: Must fill and submit the registration form available on NSP
rules.evidence_quote: Institutes/Schools desirous to onboard on NSP will make request by filling up a registration form available on NSP.

rules.description: The registration form must contain the institute’s basic information.
rules.outcome: Must capture name, address, registration number, affiliation, contact number, email, etc.
rules.evidence_quote: This registration form will capture details of the Institute/School viz. name, address, registration number, affiliation, contact no, email, etc.

rules.description: Institutes/Schools must also provide detailed information for each course they intend to register.
rules.condition: While registering courses on the form
rules.outcome: Must include course name, duration, recognition, annual fee, eligibility criteria, etc.
rules.evidence_quote: Additionally, the Institute / School are also required to fill up details of such courses they want to register, including name of the course, duration of the course, recognition, annual course fee, eligibility criteria of admission etc.

rules.description: A designated verifying authority must validate the institute’s details and grant approval.
rules.condition: After the registration form is submitted
rules.outcome: District authority (for Delhi & U.P.) or State authority (for all other States/UTs) verifies details and accords approval
rules.evidence_quote: Thereafter, the next verifying authority viz. District authority (for Delhi & U.P. exclusively) or State authority (for all other States/UTs), as the case may be, will verify the details of the Institute/School and accord approval to it.

rules.description: Approved institutes/schools are entered into the NSP database and receive portal login credentials.
rules.condition: Upon receipt of approval from the verifying authority
rules.outcome: Institute/School added to NSP database and provided login/password for the portal
rules.evidence_quote: Subsequently, the Institute/School will be added in the database of NSP and will be provided with credentials (login/password) for the Portal.

rules.description: Verifying authorities must also validate and approve the course information submitted.
rules.condition: When course details are entered in the registration form
rules.outcome: Authorities verify and approve those course details
rules.evidence_quote: Simultaneously, the verifying authorities will also verify and approve course details entered by the Institute/School in their registration form.

rules.description: Approved courses are recorded in the NSP database linked to the institute/school.
rules.outcome: Courses added to NSP database against the institute/school
rules.evidence_quote: On approval, these courses will be added in the NSP database against the Institute / School.

rules.description: School and course details are linked to the appropriate scholarship scheme.
rules.condition: Once school and course are added to the NSP database
rules.outcome: Details associated with the relevant scholarship scheme
rules.evidence_quote: Simultaneously, (school + course) details will also be associated with the relevant scholarship scheme.

rules.description: If an institute proposes scholarships for multiple categories, each category’s authority must verify and approve the institute’s credentials and course details.
rules.condition: Institute/School proposes to provide scholarship to more than one category
rules.outcome: Course details and credentials must be verified and approved by the verifying authorities of each respective scholarship scheme simultaneously
rules.evidence_quote: In case the School / Institute proposes to provide Scholarship to more than one category, the details of courses and credential of the School / Institute will need to be verified and approved by verifying authorities of respective scholarship schemes simultaneously.
